about: Ringshadow's weather sounds (docs/weather.md): rain = the light rain bed, downpour = the heavy rain bed (both one seamless loop; the game crossfades them on the rain rate and layers each with a copy offset by half, like the wind), thunder = distant rolling thunder after a far strike, crack = a close strike's crack and boom. The game picks thunder or crack by the strike's distance, delayed by distance / 343 m/s. Ids match the game's sound names (sfx/<name>_<n>).

entries.prompt: gentle steady rain falling on sand and rocks, soft pattering of individual raindrops, warm and calm, low and mellow, no hiss, no thunder, no wind
torrential rainstorm outdoors, thick drumming rain on metal and rock, rushing water, full and deep, natural, no static, no thunder
distant rolling thunder far away over open desert, long low rumble slowly fading out
thunder rumbling across a wide sky at a distance, deep growl that rolls and echoes then fades
faraway thunder, soft deep boom followed by a long grumbling roll fading into rain
lightning strike very close, sudden sharp ripping thunder crack then a heavy booming rumble that fades
nearby lightning bolt, loud explosive thunderclap with a crackling tear and a deep rolling boom after it
